title: Forever We Will Sing
lyrics: I will [Em]seek You in the m[D]orning,
And I will [C2]learn to walk in Your [Am7(4)]ways.
And I will [C/G]follow You all of my [G]da[C2]ys.[F2][C2]
And I will [C2]follow You all of my days
And I will follow You all of my days
We [F2]honor You, Lord Jesus and for[C]ever we will sing.
For [F2]You alone are worthy, and for[C]ever we will sing.
We honor You, Lord Jesus! (We honor You, Lord Jesus!)
We [Em7]lift Your name on high! (Lift your name on high!)
We [F2]honor You, Lord Jesus and for[C]ever we will sing.
For [F2]You alone are worthy, and for[C]ever we will sing.
